product_metadata.title: HOUSE AGAIN Tea Infuser Basket, Extra Fine Mesh Tea Strainers for Loose Tea, 18/8 Stainless Steel Loose Leaf Tea Steeper with Coaster Lid and Double-sided Handle, Tea Diffuser with Large Capacity
features: 【Roomy Basket】The tea infuser has a shape and size(3in x 2.6in) that allowed water and tea leaves to mingle with generous fluidity, which leads to the fragrance emanating and filling your nostrils as the tea leaves stretch out. Besides, owing to its size, the tea diffuser fits well into multiple sizes of mugs, cups and teapots.
【Extra fine mesh】The mesh of the House Again tea filters, thanks to a more advanced perforation process, can be micron-sized to trap in the smallest tea particles. No tea dregs to bother you.
【Dual-function Lid】This tea strainer lid retains both heat and aroma during the brewing process. After that it can flip over to serve as a coaster in avoidance of dripping mess.
【Food grade stainless steel】Crafted of 18/8 food-grade stainless steel (one of the most durable and reliable materials), our tea steeper can achieve superb rust resistance and easy cleaning.

【Perfect gifts】The tea infusers for loose tea are a must-have for all tea lovers, and at the same time, they are perfect gifts for various holidays and leisure occasions. Choose House Again tea infuser, flavorful tea at your fingertips!
